_doc: Display-only characters for the Japanese font glyph ids that defs/dialogs/charmap_jp.json leaves out (it lists the first occurrence of each character only, and the dialog converter writes every other id as <XXXX> so that the conversion stays lossless). The translation worksheet (tools/translate/export.py via common.render_reference) uses this table to show the Japanese text without <XXXX> placeholders. It is NOT used by the dialog converter or the build. Every id of the Japanese font (assets/fonts/jp, ids $0000-$027F) is either in charmap_jp.json or listed here; the readings were verified against the glyph images.
